facts.claim: toolPermissions in settings.json: permission.type is allow, deny, webhook-policy or script-policy; first matching rule wins; terminal rules take shellInputRegex.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: If no rule matches, the CLI follows its implicit runtime behavior; across policies the most restrictive wins (deny > webhook-policy > script-policy > allow).
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Auggie runs commands and tools automatically; only use integrations and MCP servers from trusted sources.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: A bare-string permission value ("permission": "deny") is malformed and dropped.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: toolPermissions is honored by the Auggie CLI and Cosmos cloud agents, not enforced in the Augment code extension.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D01.rationale: toolPermissions rules (allow/deny/webhook-policy/script-policy, first-match, regex on shell input) exist, but unmatched tools follow an 'implicit runtime behavior' and docs say Auggie runs commands and tools automatically; rules are not enforced in the IDE extension.

facts.claim: No OS sandbox setting appears in the CLI reference or permissions docs read (absence; sandbox may exist undocumented).
facts.label: unverified

D02.rationale: No sandbox documented for Auggie CLI.

facts.claim: Tools can be disabled per session (--remove-tool) or persistently (removedTools in settings.json); no domain allowlist documented.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D03.rationale: No egress/domain allowlist documented; web-fetch/web-search can be removed via --remove-tool or removedTools.

facts.claim: Project settings .augment/settings.json and .augment/settings.local.json load automatically and may ship hooks that apply to all contributors.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: The interactive indexing confirmation can be skipped with --allow-indexing.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D04.rationale: Repo-level .augment/settings.json (permissions, hooks) is applied automatically to anyone running in the repo; no folder-trust prompt documented; the only prompt is an indexing confirmation (--allow-indexing skips it).

facts.claim: MCP servers: mcpServers key in ~/.augment/settings.json (entries: type http|sse|stdio, url, command, args, env, headers); auggie mcp add persists there; ${workspaceFolder} expands.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D05.rationale: MCP servers configured in ~/.augment/settings.json (mcpServers) or --mcp-config; no approval/allowlist or change detection documented for the CLI.

facts.claim: Skills load automatically from .augment/skills/ and .claude/skills/ in workspace and home; plugins come from marketplaces.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D06.rationale: Plugins and marketplaces, skills from .augment/skills and .claude/skills load automatically; vetting not documented.

facts.claim: auggie login stores the token locally; auggie token print prints session JSON for automation; auggie token revoke revokes all tokens; AUGMENT_SESSION_AUTH env carries session JSON.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D07.rationale: Session token stored locally by auggie login; AUGMENT_SESSION_AUTH passes the session JSON via env; auggie token print outputs the stored session; storage mechanism (keychain vs file) not documented.

facts.claim: auggie --print runs a single instruction and exits; non-interactive mode may be disabled if not included in an enterprise agreement; --max-turns limits turns; service accounts exist for automation.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: CI sessions run with the integration configuration of the user who created the session token.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D08.rationale: --print non-interactive mode may be disabled by enterprise agreement; authenticates with a user's session JSON (service accounts documented); permissions in print mode fall to implicit behavior unless rules set.

facts.claim: Rules precedence: --rules file, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, <workspace>/.augment-guidelines, <workspace>/.augment/rules/, ~/.augment/rules/.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D09.rationale: Rules from CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .augment-guidelines, .augment/rules and ~/.augment/rules; no autonomous memory documented in pages read.

D10.rationale: N/A (not assessed: subagent isolation not read).

facts.claim: auggie --log-file <path> writes logs (default a temp file); --log-level error|warn|info|debug.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D11.rationale: Log file via --log-file (default temp file); sessions saved and shareable; enterprise audit log not verified.

facts.claim: Augment states it never trains on customers' proprietary data/code; SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 42001, customer-managed encryption keys offered.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: Auggie automatically indexes the workspace (--allow-indexing skips the confirmation).
facts.label: from-official-docs

D12.rationale: Vendor states it never trains on customer proprietary code; CLI telemetry opt-out not documented; code is indexed on Augment servers.

facts.claim: Install: npm install -g @augmentcode/auggie (Node 20+); AUGMENT_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE disables auto updates.
facts.label: from-official-docs

facts.claim: npm @augmentcode/auggie latest 0.36.0 (2026-08-21), license 'SEE LICENSE IN LICENSE.md' (custom proprietary license, Augment Computing, Inc.).

D13.rationale: Distributed via npm (@augmentcode/auggie, proprietary license); auto-update on by default, AUGMENT_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE disables; no signature/provenance documented.

facts.claim: /etc/augment/settings.json (Linux/macOS) and C:\ProgramData\Augment\settings.json (Windows) are system-wide, highest precedence, cannot be overridden by any other config source.
facts.label: from-official-docs

D14.rationale: System-wide immutable settings at /etc/augment/settings.json and C:\ProgramData\Augment\settings.json take precedence over all other sources (documented in the hooks page).
